title: Testabdeckung und Qualitäts-Gate
description: As a reviewer, I want the build to fail below 80 percent coverage, so that quality is enforced and not just intended.

acceptance_criteria.given: a change is pushed to a branch
acceptance_criteria.then: the pipeline executes unit, integration and end to end tests and reports the line coverage of backend and frontend
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-031-coverage-gate.feature: The pipeline runs tests and measures coverage

acceptance_criteria.given: the measured line coverage is 74 percent
acceptance_criteria.when: the pipeline evaluates the coverage gate
acceptance_criteria.then: the pipeline fails with the missing percentage and the change cannot be merged
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-031-coverage-gate.feature: Coverage below the threshold fails the build

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer changes a repository query
acceptance_criteria.when: the pipeline runs the integration tests
acceptance_criteria.then: the cross tenant test runs against a real database and fails when a query loses its organisation filter
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-031-coverage-gate.feature: The tenant isolation test is part of the mandatory set
